clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  General requirements for materials, sizes methods of test and inspection, and marking of all types of fabricated PVC fittings for jointing with solvent cement to the PVC pipes covered in IS  4985 : 1988 for portable water supplies.  This specification covers the sizes of fittings from 63 to 315 mm.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material —The pipes used for the fabrication of PVC fittings for portable water supplies shall conform to IS  4985 :  2000*

clauses.title: Size of
clauses.text: 3. Size of  Fitting —The size of fittings shall be designated by the nominal diameters of the pipe given in IS  4985  :  2000 with which they are to be used.

clauses.title: Socket Length and
clauses.text: 4. Socket Length and  Diameter  at Mid-Point of  Socket Length

clauses.title: Minimum socket length ‘L’
clauses.text: 4.1 Minimum socket length 'L' of any fitting shall be given by L=0.5D + 6 mm where D is the nominal inside diameter of the fitting. The minimum socket lengths based on the above  formula for  different  socket diameters are given in  Table 1.

clauses.title: Out
clauses.text: 4.2 Out-of-Roundness Tolerances of Socket Inside Diameter:  the maximum  of out-of-roundness tolerances (maximum diameter-minimum diameter) shall be : a)  Equal to 0.007 D, or b)  Equal to 0.2 mm (if 0.007D is less than 0.2 mm), Note— Out of roundness tolerances of socket inside diameter shall not apply to fittings of nominal  pressure rating 0.25 MPa (Class1), 0.4 MPa

clauses.title: Short term Hydraulic Test
clauses.text: 5.2 Short term Hydraulic Test — The fittings shall withstand a pressure of  4.2 times the working pressure for one hour without failure Note— For methods of tests, refer to Appendices A and B of the  standard.
